headline: Then-CPO Mike Krieger to the FT: "We will do voice internally … We have prototypes." Voice mode then shipped on a partner's text-to-speech.
note: Mike Krieger (then CPO) to the Financial Times, early March 2025: 'We will do voice internally ... We have prototypes'; the FT also reported talks with Amazon and ElevenLabs. first_seen_date APPROXIMATE: 'early March 2025', day unknown, set to the 1st. Original FT interview not opened (paywall); relays opened 2026-11-10: TechCrunch 2025-05-27 and progressiverobot.com 2026-10-10. Voice mode then shipped on 2025-05-27 with a partner's text-to-speech, so this did not lead to a first-party speech model within 20 months.

headline: Job posting for an Audio research team building "end-to-end conversational systems" and "speech synthesis"; listed from at least January to July 2026, gone from the board by November.
note: JOB_POSTING: 'Research Engineer/Research Scientist, Audio' on Anthropic's Greenhouse board (job 5074815008). Text: the Audio team builds 'end-to-end conversational systems, speech and audio understanding models, and speech synthesis capabilities' and trains 'large-scale speech language models'. first_seen_date APPROXIMATE: earliest Wayback capture listed by the availability API is 2026-01-20 (capture itself would not load). Relay copies opened 2026-11-10 (Mediabistro, datePosted 2026-07-15; jobs.therundown.ai). The first-party posting returned 404 on 2026-11-10 and no job with audio, speech or voice in its title is on the board (675 jobs fetched 2026-11-10 19:40 UTC): closed or filled, not known which.

headline: Anthropic starts asking mobile users to share voice recordings "to evaluate and improve voice mode and dictation", reversing its no-voice-training line.
note: Opt-in to share voice-mode and dictation recordings with Anthropic (iOS and Android; off by default; separate from the text-training setting). Help-center article fetched 2026-11-10 19:35 UTC: recordings are used 'to evaluate and improve voice mode and dictation'. first_seen_date from BleepingComputer 2026-10-04 (opened), which quotes the in-app prompt: recordings 'help improve how Anthropic AI models understand and respond to speech'. Reverses the privacy-center line 'We do not use your voice for training our models' (still on privacy.claude.com, fetched 2026-11-10). Names no model and no date.

headline: TestingCatalog screenshot: a hidden "Voice" item marked "Preview" in Claude's web navigation. Nothing ties it to a new model.
note: TestingCatalog: a hidden 'Voice' item with a 'Preview' badge in Claude's web navigation, next to the existing voice-mode button; the badge is said to mark Anthropic's internal preview environment. Screenshot only, not desk-verified, so grade C. Article opened 2026-11-10. It says nothing about a new model: the item could be a redesign of the current pipeline. Relays: orcarouter.ai and progressiverobot.com 2026-10-10 (opened).

headline: Engineering job posting gives "ship a new multimodal data type (audio, video, etc) to production" as a sample project.
note: JOB_POSTING: 'Software Engineer, Tokens and Prompt Structures' lists as a representative project 'Working with a research team to ship a new multimodal data type (audio, video, etc) to production'. Greenhouse API fetched 2026-11-10 19:40 UTC (first_published 2026-09-16). An example, not a commitment; shown for context and given no weight.

headline: Anthropic spokesperson to Engadget: voice mode "uses a turn-based architecture". The July upgrade routed text models through the existing pipeline.
note: Engadget, 2026-07-23 (opened 2026-11-10): an Anthropic spokesperson said voice mode 'uses a turn-based architecture'; it is not full duplex. Same day Anthropic moved voice mode to Opus and Sonnet on web, desktop and mobile. Evidence that the shipped system was still a cascaded pipeline in July 2026.

headline: API docs: every current model takes text and image in and gives text out. No audio page, endpoint or price; Fable 5.2 is not offered in voice mode.
note: Models overview fetched 2026-11-10 19:35 UTC: 'All current models support text and image input, text output'. No audio, speech, voice or realtime page in the docs index (platform.claude.com/llms.txt), the API release notes or the pricing page. The Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 launch page (2026-11-09) announces no audio capability, and the voice-mode help page says Fable is not available in voice mode.

headline: ElevenLabs named as text-to-speech subprocessor in 2025 (relay). Whether it still is, and who does speech-to-text, is not documented.
note: SUBPROCESSOR: The Decoder (opened 2026-11-10) relays Simon Willison's find that Anthropic's subprocessor list names ElevenLabs for text-to-speech. trust.anthropic.com/subprocessors is rendered by script and could not be read on 2026-11-10, so whether ElevenLabs is still listed is NOT VERIFIED. Who does speech-to-text is not documented: the Claude Code docs say audio goes 'to Anthropic's servers for transcription' and name no model.
